name: theflock-twitter-clone
description: A Twitter/X clone built for The Flock's technical challenge — Go API + React client.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.test:coverage: cd server && go test ./internal/... -coverprofile=coverage.out -covermode=atomic && go tool cover -func=coverage.out
